header: Test vectors of type MlDsaSign are meant for the generation of ML-DSA signatures
See doc/mldsa.md for details on how to apply these test vectors.

BoundaryCondition.description: This case exercises a boundary condition (e.g. in the signing rejection loop).

ManySteps.description: This case requires many steps (e.g. many hashes in the matrix expansion, many iterations in the signing rejection loop).

Randomized.description: The signature was generated with the provided non-zero rnd value (hedged signing) instead of the deterministic all-zero value.

ValidSignature.description: The test vector contains a valid signature.

tests.comment: high_bits called on the edge case
low_bits called on the edge case
sampleNTT samples the value 0 during matrix A expansion
sampleNTT samples the value q-1 during matrix A expansion
sampleNTT encounters the value q (rejected) during matrix A expansion
decompose coefficient mod 2*gamma2 = gamma2+1 during verification
decompose coefficient mod 2*gamma2 = gamma2+2 during verification
decompose coefficient mod 2*gamma2 = gamma2 during verification
centered_mod output is 0 (coefficient is multiple of 2*gamma2) during verification
signing lowBits boundary in decompose special case (r0 adjustment flipped)
signing lowBits boundary in decompose special case (skip r0 adjustment)
valid signature where one polynomial has zero hints
